extracted.intended_audience: researchers, industry partners, national laboratories, universities, and potential DOE WETO grant applicants/partners
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on the Wind Energy Technologies Office's R&D priorities and expectations to inform proposals, partnerships, and project design for land-based, offshore, and distributed wind energy systems. Describes objectives, scope, collaboration mechanisms, and societal/economic impacts WETO seeks to achieve.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve performance, lower costs, and reduce market barriers
rubrics_metrics.description: WETO's R&D activities are aimed at improving performance, lowering costs, and reducing market barriers for U.S. wind energy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should demonstrably target one or more of these aims (performance, cost reduction, market barrier mitigation) as primary outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on novel research not being undertaken by industry
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office focuses on novel research not being undertaken by the U.S. wind industry due to perceived cost, risk, or focus on near-term funding returns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should justify why the work is beyond current industry investment because of cost/risk/short-term focus and demonstrate how DOE support will de-risk or enable the technology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target both land-based and offshore utility-scale and distribution-side systems
rubrics_metrics.description: WETO's efforts target both land-based and offshore wind power at the utility scale as well as systems on the distribution side.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scope of work should specify which domain(s)—land-based utility-scale, offshore utility-scale, or distribution-side systems—the project addresses and how it aligns with domain-specific challenges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drive down cost via efficiency, reliability, and predictability
rubrics_metrics.description: WETO is dedicated to driving down the cost of wind energy with more efficient, more reliable, and more predictable wind energy systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should include metrics or pathways demonstrating how proposed advances will increase efficiency, improve reliability, or enhance predictability and quantify expected cost impacts where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conduct R&D through competitively selected, directly funded, and cost-shared projects
rubrics_metrics.description: WETO conducts R&D activities through competitively selected, directly funded, and cost-shared projects with national labs, industry, universities, and other agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should expect competitive selection processes and be prepared for funding mechanisms that may include direct funding and cost-sharing; proposals should address budgetary match and collaboration roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop tools to identify highest-quality wind resources
rubrics_metrics.description: WETO funds development of tools to identify the highest quality wind resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that improves resource assessment, site selection tools, or resource characterization to enable better deployment decisions aligns with this criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address market and deployment barriers including siting and environmental impacts
rubrics_metrics.description: WETO funds R&D that addresses market and deployment barriers, including siting and environmental impacts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should identify specific market/deployment barriers (e.g., permitting, siting constraints, environmental concerns) and propose actionable strategies or technologies to mitigate them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure stable, secure grid integration of wind power
rubrics_metrics.description: WETO works to ensure the stable, secure integration of wind power into the nation's electrical grid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should consider grid integration issues (e.g., interconnection, stability, cybersecurity, transmission) and include plans for demonstrating or validating integration solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote domestic manufacturing and strengthen U.S. competitiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: WETO is committed to promoting domestic manufacturing of wind power technologies and enhancing U.S. competitiveness in the global wind market.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals that support domestic supply chains, manufacturing scale-up, or workforce development and that articulate impacts on U.S. competitiveness are aligned with WETO priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhance energy security and independence
rubrics_metrics.description: WETO supports leveraging land-based, offshore, and distributed wind resources to provide energy security and independence at local, state, and national levels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should explain how outcomes will contribute to stable, reliable, and cost-effective domestic energy options and hedging against fuel price volatility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deliver local economic value: jobs, infrastructure, and rural revitalization
rubrics_metrics.description: WETO aims to expand infrastructure, grow domestic manufacturing, create skilled jobs, and revitalize rural America.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should describe expected socio-economic benefits such as job creation, local investment, and impacts on rural or disadvantaged communities where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enable nationwide cost-effective electricity deployment
rubrics_metrics.description: WETO supports enabling wind energy to provide cost-effective electricity across the United States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should consider national scalability and demonstrate how innovations will support broader deployment across varied geographies and markets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage partnerships with national laboratories, industry, universities, and agencies
rubrics_metrics.description: WETO works in close cooperation with national laboratories, industry, universities, and other agencies and offers flexible ways to partner with national labs to access unique capabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strong collaborative plans that leverage lab capabilities, industry know-how, and academic expertise are encouraged; describe roles, capabilities accessed, and partnership structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support R&D that complements transmission and siting development
rubrics_metrics.description: Technological advancements combined with continued siting and transmission development are necessary for wind to provide cost-effective electricity nationwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should demonstrate awareness of transmission and siting constraints and align R&D so that technological gains can be realized in concert with these development activities.
